hook.name: MidasAntiSnipeSuperhook
hook.description: ETH/token hook that charges configurable fees on both sides of each swap — ETH-side fees are split between a royalty recipient and the pool's adopter, token-side swaps burn a configurable amount to a dead address. Buys within a configurable post-launch window pay a linearly-decaying anti-snipe surcharge. Includes an on-chain TWAP oracle and rejects fee-on-transfer tokens and exact-output swaps.
